notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is structurally catalogued here but blocked at the account level — DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN not set. Same blocker as uk-west-midlands / uk-ellesmere-port / east-midlands / south-yorkshire / north-east / west-of-england.

Single agency (National Rail), single mode (train). Transport for Wales Valley Lines is deliberately EXCLUDED — no confirmed public GTFS static or GTFS-RT feed of any kind exists for TfW (report confidence 'not found' throughout); this is a genuine feed-doesn't-exist gap, not the usual account block. See docs/south-wales-d1/jim-handoff.md.

A reference static GTFS dump for National Rail exists (Transitland, CC-BY-2.0 UK) but is NOT used to build this catalog's station list — the two stations below are taken directly from the oracle report's station name table.

No doNotGroup needed — Cardiff Central is a shared physical hub with Valley Lines on separate infrastructure (footbridge connect), but there is no Valley Lines board to group against since Valley Lines has no feed at all.

Severn Tunnel Junction (STJ) is catalogued flat as through-running-only, NOT a merge point. This pack's oracle report names STJ as the Wales-England boundary; West of England's already-merged pack instead names Chepstow (CPW) for the same corridor — a boundary discrepancy NOT reconciled here, flagged for D2/Tim. See docs/south-wales-d1/jim-handoff.md and hazard-pack.md.
